entries.zh: 这部历史小说讲述了一位让位者远离首都平静生活的故事。

entries.zh: 店主们决定联合起来修复市场拱廊。

entries.zh: 音乐杂志介绍了一位十六岁就创作了第一部交响曲的青年才俊。

entries.en: The young founder became the industry's wonder boy after the successful launch.
entries.zh: 成功推出产品后，这位年轻创始人成了行业里的风云才俊。

entries.zh: 接待员悄悄指了指总部来访的大人物。

entries.en: The training case listed shortness of breath among the recorded observations.
entries.zh: 培训病例将气促列为记录下来的观察情况之一。

entries.en: The editor asked us to straighten out the contradictory dates in the article.
entries.zh: 编辑要求我们澄清文章中相互矛盾的日期。

entries.en: The fictional explorer wanted to reach the summit at all costs.
entries.zh: 虚构的探险者想不惜任何代价登上山顶。

entries.en: The animation showed floodwater beginning to flow away through the drainage channel.
entries.zh: 动画显示洪水开始经排水渠流走。

entries.zh: 博物馆将一支古董气枪与其他运动器材一同展出。

entries.zh: 标注图展示了外展神经从脑干通向眼部的路径。

entries.zh: 解剖动画演示了一块外展肌的作用。

entries.zh: 热力学练习比较了反应前后的自由能。

entries.en: The partners celebrated a business deal with their first overseas customer.

entries.zh: 售票机停止工作时，我变得着急慌乱。

entries.zh: 质量检查员调查了一批产品偏离常态的情况。

entries.zh: 博物馆发布新闻稿，宣布修复后的画作回归。

entries.zh: 我们看见魔术师从剧院侧门悄悄离开。

entries.zh: 研讨会比较了经济增长与家庭支出的变化。

entries.zh: 木匠在安装最后一块搁板前测量了壁柜。

entries.zh: 影片首次公开放映后，电影明星回答了提问。

entries.zh: 光学模型包含一块阻挡较低频率光的高通滤光片。

entries.zh: 历史论文考察了对微生物出现所作的自然发生论解释。

entries.en: I had to rush off before the final question was answered.
entries.zh: 最后一个问题得到回答前，我就不得不匆匆离开。

entries.en: The historical infant-feeding survey included questions about the timing of ablactation.
entries.zh: 这项早期婴儿喂养调查包含有关断奶时间的问题。

entries.en: The linguistics tutor illustrated ablaut with related verb forms.
entries.zh: 语言学导师用相关的动词形式演示了元音交替。

entries.en: The emergency drill assigned different tasks to able-bodied volunteers and those needing assistance.
entries.zh: 应急演习给身体强健的志愿者与需要协助者分配了不同任务。

entries.en: The builders planned to knock off early before the storm arrived.
entries.zh: 建筑工人计划在暴风雨到来前提早收工。

entries.en: The training record described the athlete's physical condition before the event.
entries.zh: 训练记录描述了运动员赛前的身体状况。

entries.en: The carpenter began to chalk out the shelf design on a spare board.
entries.zh: 木匠开始在一块备用木板上画架子的草图。

entries.en: The narrator decides to cast away the broken compass before leaving the island.
entries.zh: 叙述者决定在离岛前丢弃坏掉的指南针。

entries.en: The banking exercise included a fictional stop payment request for a lost check.
entries.zh: 银行业务练习包含一项针对遗失支票的虚构止付请求。

entries.en: The report described excluding qualified wheelchair users from interviews as able-bodiedism.
entries.zh: 报告将把合格的轮椅使用者排除在面试之外描述为歧视残疾人。

entries.en: The panel discussed able-bodism in the design of public transport.
entries.zh: 小组讨论了公共交通设计中的残疾人歧视。

entries.en: The student group challenged ableism in assumptions about who could join the expedition.
entries.zh: 学生团体质疑了有关谁能参加考察的假设中的健全至上偏见。

entries.en: The gardeners will rail off the newly planted section.
entries.zh: 园丁们将用栏杆隔开新种植的区域。

entries.en: The fallen branch damaged the telephone line to the farmhouse.
entries.zh: 落下的树枝损坏了通往农舍的电话线路。

entries.en: The workstation was designed for a power user running demanding simulations.
entries.zh: 这台工作站是为运行高负荷仿真的高要求用户设计的。

entries.en: The laboratory built a test bed for evaluating the new motor.
entries.zh: 实验室搭建了一个评估新电动机的试验台。

entries.en: We planned to sleep late after the overnight train journey.
entries.zh: 通宵坐火车后，我们打算睡个懒觉。

entries.en: The mock court issued a cease and desist order against the fictional advertiser.
entries.zh: 模拟法庭向虚构的广告商发出了禁止命令。

entries.en: The packaging trial compared the shelf life of two sealed food samples.
entries.zh: 包装试验比较了两份密封食品样品的保存期限。

entries.en: The historical ophthalmology atlas included a drawing labeled ablepharia.
entries.zh: 这本旧眼科图谱包含一幅标注为无睑畸形的绘图。

entries.en: The orchard was abloom when the painters arrived in spring.
entries.zh: 画家们春天到来时，果园正繁花盛开。

entries.en: The historian described the courtyard's ablutionary facilities before the prayer hall entrance.
entries.zh: 历史学者描述了庭院里位于祈祷厅入口前的净身沐浴设施。

entries.meaningZh: 穿着极炫目的衣服吸引异性
entries.en: She arrived dressed to kill, hoping to attract the man she had invited.
entries.zh: 她衣着艳丽地到场，希望吸引她邀请的那位男子。

entries.en: The study recorded environmental conditions alongside each soil measurement.
entries.zh: 研究在每次土壤测量值旁记录了环境状况。

entries.en: The music teacher replaced four quarter notes with one whole note.
entries.zh: 音乐教师把四个四分音符换成了一个全音符。

entries.en: She made the free throw that tied the basketball game.
entries.zh: 她罚球命中，将篮球比赛的比分扳平。

entries.en: The economics case examined price competition between two neighborhood supermarkets.
entries.zh: 经济学案例考察了两家社区超市之间的价格竞争。

entries.en: The equipment display showed a damaged face guard on a football helmet.
entries.zh: 器材展览展示了一顶橄榄球头盔上受损的防护面具。

entries.en: The photographer adjusted the room light before arranging the display.
entries.zh: 摄影师在布置展示之前调整了室内照明。

entries.en: The biographer depicts the monk as an abnegator of worldly wealth.
entries.zh: 传记作者将这位僧人描绘成世俗财富的舍弃者。

entries.en: The anatomical drawing documented a congenital abnormalcy of the hand.
entries.zh: 解剖绘图记录了一种手部先天畸形。

entries.en: The dental teaching model illustrated abocclusion between the upper and lower front teeth.
entries.zh: 牙科教学模型展示了上下前牙之间的咬合不密。

entries.en: The farmer repaired the fence around the chicken run.
entries.zh: 农场主修好了鸡栏周围的围栏。

entries.en: The United States Air Force museum traced the history of an air division.
entries.zh: 美国空军博物馆追溯了一个空军师的历史。

entries.en: The old advertisement showed a bottle of baby oil beside a folded towel.
entries.zh: 旧广告展示了一瓶放在折叠毛巾旁的婴儿润肤油。

entries.en: The cook waited for the milk to settle before beginning to cream off the top layer.
entries.zh: 厨师等牛奶静置后才开始撇去上层乳油。

entries.en: The museum displayed the officer's service cap beside a photograph.
entries.zh: 博物馆在一张照片旁展示了那位军官的军帽。

entries.en: At long last, the restored clock began to strike again.
entries.zh: 修复后的钟终于又开始报时了。

entries.en: The quarterback completed a forward pass to the receiver near the sideline.
entries.zh: 四分卫向边线附近的接球员完成了一次前传。
